_comments: What KIND of standard-terms document a ContractTemplate is a version of. Two rows, and only one
of them has a real template behind it today.
Master Agreement is the whole point: the numbered-provision document that Order Forms and
Payment Links incorporate, versioned by date, whose clause list becomes ContractTemplateProvision
Statement of Work is seeded but UNUSED, on purpose. Amith, 2026-08-18: SOWs have standard
language but no versioned template. Seeding the type row now means registering the first real
SOW template later is data entry rather than a migration — and it documents that the absence is
a fact about the business, not a hole in the seed.

fields.Name: Master Agreement
fields.Description: The numbered-provision standard-terms document, versioned by publication date. Every Order Form and Payment Link incorporates one version of it, and a negotiated deviation from one of its provisions is a Contract Template Modification.

fields.Name: Statement of Work
fields.Description: Standard SOW language. Seeded so the type exists; no versioned template is registered against it yet, because the business does not version its SOW language (Amith, 2026-08-18).
